Spare parts, sheet 23 — cell 3

Q 25   push button contact block, NC   quantity 4   fits the EAO body on sheet 21
summary: The spare-parts row for the push-button contact block and the body it fits.
note: F3 — printed with a space inside the code. `lookup("Q25")` reaches it through the letter↔digit boundary variant, which is the variant that exists for exactly this spelling.
